### Props

| Name         | Type      | Required | Default | Description                                                                     |
| ------------ | --------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `def`        | `object`  | ✓        | —       | The filter definition from `columnFilterDef`.                                   |
| `state`      | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | The column's current state from `columnFilterState`.                            |
| `label`      | `string`  |          | `''`    | The translated column label.                                                    |
| `anchorRect` | `object`  |          | `null`  | The filter button's bounding rect, to place the panel under it.                 |
| `register`   | `string`  |          | `''`    | Register slug a reference column's objects live in, when the column names none. |
| `teleport`   | `boolean` |          | `true`  | Render into `&lt;body&gt;`, so a scrolling table cannot clip the panel.         |

### Events

| Name    | Payload | Description                              |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `apply` | —       | The person applied the filter.           |
| `close` | —       | The panel should close without applying. |
